INSERT INTO calls
             (id, phone_number_id, provider, provider_call_id, to_e164, from_e164,
              owner_user_id, agent_id)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
           ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_call_id)
             DO UPDATE SET started_at = calls.started_at
           RETURNING id
